description: Malware families, tools and threat actors with the evasion techniques public reporting attributes to them. Every entry cites its sources; 'weight' is the family's share of the reference population used by the threat-survival score.

threats.name: GuLoader

evidence.detail: Measures RDTSC deltas around CPUID(EAX=1) 100000 times (0x186A0) and loops forever if the sum exceeds 0x68E7780, i.e. if VM exits make CPUID slow.
Executes CPUID leaf 1 and tests ECX bit 31; when set it shows 'The program cannot be run under virtual Environment or debugging software!' and exits.
Counts top-level windows with EnumWindows and terminates if fewer than 12 are open.
Enumerates loaded device drivers (EnumDeviceDrivers/GetDeviceDriverBaseName) and compares DJB2 hashes of their names with VM driver names.
Scans its process memory with NtQueryVirtualMemory for DJB2 hashes of VMware/Hyper-V window-class strings (vmtoolsdControlWndClass, VMSwitchUserControlClass, VM3DService Hidden Window).
Tries to open C:\Program Files\Qemu-ga\qemu-ga.exe and C:\Program Files\qga\qga.exe (QEMU guest agent).
Detects user-mode hooks placed by sandboxes on ntdll functions before using them.

threats.weight_basis: ANY.RUN lists GuLoader among the most active loaders in its quarterly trend reports; CrowdStrike (2022) calls it one of the most evasive commodity downloaders. Placed one step below the ANY.RUN 2025 top-10 families.

threats.name: Raspberry Robin

evidence.detail: Reads PEB BeingDebugged, NtGlobalFlag and heap ForceFlags.
Reads KdDebuggerEnabled from KUSER_SHARED_DATA.
Fails if fewer than two active processors.
Reads NumberOfPhysicalPages from KUSER_SHARED_DATA and fails under 800 MB.
Compares the user name with an embedded blocklist.
Compares its own executable name with a blocklist (including 'loaddll').
Compares loaded module names with a blocklist.
Compares the CPU name with a blocklist.
Compares the CPUID hypervisor vendor string with default IDs such as 'Microsoft hv' and 'VMwareVMware'.
Uses CPUID hypervisor detection; if the hypervisor leaf is hidden it checks further whether the machine is a hypervisor.
Looks for files common in sandbox and analysis environments.
Checks the product ID of PhysicalDrive0.
Compares the monitor display name with a blocklist.
Compares host MAC addresses with a blocklist.
Compares running process names with a blocklist.
Reads the firmware table through SystemFirmwareTableInformation and checks it against a blocklist.
Looks for session named objects such as HGFSMUTEX and HGFSMEMORY (VMware shared folders).
Treats Office VBAWarnings set to enable all macros as an analysis-machine sign.
Checks Windows APIs for inline hooks.
First layer uses GS/CS segment-register behaviour to detect code emulation.
The decoy payload requires uptime above 13 minutes.
Queries CPU temperature information (ATT&CK S1130, citing HP Wolf Security, 10 Apr 2024).

threats.weight_basis: Widely reported USB-worm/initial-access loader (ATT&CK S1130; Check Point 2023; Zscaler 2024) but absent from the ANY.RUN 2024/2025 top-10 tables: second-tier commodity weight.

threats.name: Lumma Stealer

evidence.detail: LummaC2 v4.0 waits for cursor movement, samples five positions 50 ms apart and only runs if the angles between successive movement vectors stay below 45 degrees.
Loader checks the foreground window title for x32dbg, x64dbg, windbg, ollydbg, dnspy, ida and similar strings.
Loader checks for SbieDll.dll, cmdvrt64.dll, cuckoomon.dll and SxIn.dll.
Loader looks up wine_get_unix_file_name to detect Wine.
Loader compares the user name with Johnson, Miller, malware, maltest, CurrentUser, Sandbox, virus, John Doe, test user, sand box, WDAGUtilityAccount.
Loader queries Win32_ComputerSystem manufacturer/model for innotek GmbH, Microsoft Corporation, VirtualBox, VMware.
Loader checks C:\Program Files\VMware, VirtualBox Guest Additions and driver files such as balloon.sys, netkvm.sys, VBoxGuest.sys, vmmouse.sys in System32.
Loader checks for the vmbus, VMBusHID and hyperkbd services.
Loader checks for vboxservice, VGAuthService, vmusrvc and qemu-ga processes.
Checks GPU configuration for sandbox detection (ATT&CK S1213, citing Trend Micro, 30 Jan 2025).

threats.weight_basis: ANY.RUN 2025 annual report: #1 family with 31,111 detections (2024: #1 with 12,655).

threats.name: Pikabot

evidence.detail: Raises INT 2D and INT 3 exceptions and reads the trap flag via __readeflags.
Reads PEB BeingDebugged and NtGlobalFlag, calls IsDebuggerPresent/CheckRemoteDebuggerPresent and OutputDebugString.
Calls NtQueryInformationProcess with ProcessDebugPort and ProcessDebugFlags.
Detects hardware breakpoints.
Requires at least two processors.
Requires more than 2 GB of RAM.
Stops if the system language is Georgian, Kazakh, Uzbek, Tajik, Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian or Slovenian (ATT&CK S1145, citing Zscaler 2023 and Elastic 2024).

threats.weight_basis: Distributed by TA577 at QakBot-replacement scale in late 2023 (Zscaler, Elastic); disrupted by Operation Endgame in May 2024, so weighted below current top families.

threats.name: DarkGate

evidence.detail: 'antivm' option checks the display information for VirtualBox, VMware or Hyper-V.
'antidisk' option refuses to run below a configured amount of free disk space.
'antiram' option refuses to run below a configured amount of RAM.
'antienv' option checks processor information, including whether the CPU is an Intel Xeon.
Checks the PEB BeingDebugged flag.

threats.weight_basis: Malware-as-a-service sold on Russian-language forums since 2023 with large phishing/Teams campaigns (Trellix 2023); not in ANY.RUN 2024/2025 top-10.

threats.name: Latrodectus

evidence.detail: Exits if the PEB BeingDebugged flag is set.
Exits if fewer than 75 processes run on Windows 10/11/Server 2016, or fewer than 50 on older Windows.
Calls GetAdaptersInfo and exits if the host has no valid MAC address.

threats.weight_basis: IcedID successor distributed by TA577/TA578 initial-access brokers (Proofpoint 2024); mid-tier loader, not in ANY.RUN top-10.

threats.name: Bumblebee

evidence.detail: al-khaser vbox_files/vmware_files/kvm_files: checks for driver files such as System32\drivers\VBoxMouse.sys.
al-khaser vbox_reg_keys, vmware_reg_keys, kvm_reg_keys, qemu_reg_key_value, virtual_pc_reg_keys.
al-khaser check_mac_addr, vmware_mac, xen_check_mac, vbox_mac_wmi.
al-khaser vbox_firmware_ACPI, vmware_firmware_ACPI, qemu_firmware_ACPI.
al-khaser vbox_firmware_SMBIOS, vmware_firmware_SMBIOS, qemu_firmware_SMBIOS, get_system_firmware.
al-khaser vbox_baseboard_wmi and model_computer_system_wmi.
al-khaser vbox_pnpentity_pcideviceid_wmi (PCI vendor ID 80EE).
al-khaser registry_services_disk_enum (disk enum names in the registry).
al-khaser disk_size_wmi.
al-khaser memory_space: RAM above a threshold.
al-khaser cpu_fan_wmi: Win32_Fan must return data.
al-khaser known_usernames.
al-khaser known_file_names (e.g. sample.exe).
al-khaser vbox_processes, qemu_processes, parallels_process, virtual_pc_process.
al-khaser get_services.
al-khaser vbox_window_class.
al-khaser vbox_devices and vmware_devices (\\.\VBoxGuest, \\.\HGFS...).
al-khaser wine_reg_key and wine_exports.
al-khaser mouse_movement.
Identifies analysis tools from running processes (ATT&CK S1039, citing Kaspersky 'The chronicles of Bumblebee', 27 Apr 2022).

threats.weight_basis: Conti/TrickBot-linked loader targeted by Operation Endgame (Europol, 30 May 2024); mid-tier loader weight.

threats.name: IcedID

evidence.detail: Loader runs 255 iterations of RDTSC / CPUID(1) / RDTSC and buckets the deltas; the counts go to the C2, which decides whether to deliver the core module.
Calls CPUID 0x40000000 and compares the vendor registers with Xen, Hyper-V, VMware and KVM signatures.

threats.weight_basis: Major banking trojan/loader feeding ransomware; one of the droppers taken down by Operation Endgame (Europol, 30 May 2024). Activity fell afterwards, so weighted mid-tier.

threats.name: QakBot

evidence.detail: Exits if processes such as Fiddler.exe, Procmon.exe, ProcessHacker.exe, Wireshark.exe, dumpcap.exe, idaq.exe, x32dbg.exe, OLLYDBG.EXE, windbg.exe, Tcpview.exe or samp1e.exe/sample.exe/runsample.exe run.
Exits if VBoxTray.exe, VBoxService.exe, vmtoolsd.exe, vm3dservice.exe, VGAuthService.exe, TPAutoConnect.exe or vmacthlp.exe run.
Executes IN on I/O port 0x5658 with EAX='VMXh' and command 0x0A (get version) to detect VMware.
Enumerates the device list for VMware SVGA/SCSI/Pointing, VBoxVideo, VBoxGuest, QEMU, Red Hat VirtIO, Virtual HD and similar device names.
Checks whether its own file name is a default analysis name such as sample.exe or malware.exe.

threats.weight_basis: Named in the CISA/ACSC list of top malware strains of 2021 (AA22-216A); not in the ANY.RUN 2024/2025 top-10, so weight 1.0.

threats.name: SmokeLoader

evidence.detail: Calls GetKeyboardLayout and stops on Russian/Ukrainian layouts.
Checks the PEB BeingDebugged flag and NtGlobalFlag.
Reads disk device names under System\CurrentControlSet\Enum\IDE and \SCSI and looks for qemu, virtio, vmware, vbox.
Calls NtQuerySystemInformation(SystemCodeIntegrityInformation) to detect test-signing/unsigned-driver policy, common on sandboxes.
Checks for loaded sbiedll, aswhook and snxhk modules.
Looks for qemu-ga.exe, qga.exe, windanr.exe, vboxservice.exe, vboxtray.exe, vmtoolsd.exe, prl_tools.exe.
Enumerates loaded kernel modules for vmci.s, vmusbm, vmmous, vm3dmp, vboxgu, vboxsf, vioser and others.
Checks whether the executable path matches [A-F0-9]{4}.vmt.

threats.weight_basis: ANY.RUN 2025 annual report names Smoke Loader first among the widespread loaders; also targeted by Operation Endgame (Europol 2024).

threats.name: AsyncRAT

evidence.detail: Anti_Analysis.DetectManufacturer (builder option): Win32_ComputerSystem Manufacturer 'microsoft corporation' with a VIRTUAL model, 'vmware', or Model 'VirtualBox' -> Environment.FailFast.
DetectDebugger: CheckRemoteDebuggerPresent.
DetectSandboxie: GetModuleHandle('SbieDll.dll').
IsSmallDisk: exits when the system drive is 61,000,000,000 bytes or smaller.

threats.weight_basis: ANY.RUN 2025 annual report: #3 family with 16,372 detections (2024: #3, 8,257).

threats.name: XWorm

evidence.detail: WMI 'Select * from Win32_ComputerSystem' checked for VMware or VirtualBox.
CheckRemoteDebuggerPresent.
Checks whether SbieDll.dll (Sandboxie) is loaded.
Queries whether the machine's public IP is hosted or in a data centre (ip-api.com ?fields=hosting) and exits if so.

threats.weight_basis: ANY.RUN 2025 annual report: #2 family with 31,093 detections (2024 top-10: #6, 7,237).

threats.name: Agent Tesla

evidence.detail: Queries WMI for a manufacturer of VMware, VirtualBox or Microsoft Corporation (Hyper-V).
Looks for snxhk.dll (Avast), SbieDll.dll (Sandboxie) and cmdvrt32.dll (Comodo) in its process.
Queries ip-api.com for the 'hosting' field and stops on hosting/data-centre addresses.
Checks Win32_VideoController names for VMware/VBox adapters.
Records the tick count, sleeps 10 ms and flags an emulator/sandbox if less time elapsed than slept.
CheckRemoteDebuggerPresent.

threats.weight_basis: ANY.RUN 2025 annual report: #5 with 14,584 detections (2024: #2, 8,443); CISA AA22-216A top malware strain of 2021.

threats.name: Remcos

evidence.detail: Checks for SbieDll.dll (Sandboxie).
Checks the registry key created by VirtualBox Guest Additions.
Loader's vectored exception handler reads Dr0-Dr7 and treats non-zero values as a debugger.
Loader calls ZwQueryInformationProcess(ProcessDebugPort).

threats.weight_basis: ANY.RUN 2025 annual report: #4 with 16,002 detections (2024: #4, 8,004); CISA AA22-216A top malware strain of 2021.

threats.name: StealC

evidence.detail: Exits if the user name is JohnDoe (Microsoft Defender emulator default).
Exits if the computer name is HAL9TH (Microsoft Defender emulator default).
Exits on language IDs 0x419 ru-RU, 0x422 uk-UA, 0x423 be-BY, 0x43F kk-KZ, 0x443 uz-UZ.
Terminates if fewer than two active processors.
Terminates if GlobalMemoryStatusEx reports too little memory (below about 1 GB).
Exits if no display is configured.

threats.weight_basis: ANY.RUN 2025 annual report: #9 with 9,927 detections (2024: #5, 7,653).

threats.name: Vidar

evidence.detail: Calls ZwQueryInformationProcess for ProcessDebugPort and ProcessDebugFlags (ATT&CK S9050, citing Joshi 2026 and Quorum Cyber).
Calls IsDebuggerPresent (ATT&CK S9050, citing CYFIRMA, 3 Jun 2024).

threats.weight_basis: ANY.RUN 2025 annual report: #8 with 10,303 detections.

threats.name: RedLine Stealer

evidence.detail: Anti-sandbox: keeps checking in with its C2 and does not continue if the connection fails (ATT&CK S1240, citing Splunk Threat Research, 1 Jun 2023).

threats.weight_basis: ANY.RUN 2024 annual report: #7 with 7,189 detections (2023: #1, 9,205).

threats.name: FormBook / XLoader (Windows)

evidence.detail: Walks the PEB for sbiedll.dll and for module paths containing \cuckoo\, \sandcastle\, \aswsnx\, \smpdir\, \avctestsuite\.
Exits if procmon.exe, filemon.exe, regmon.exe, wireshark.exe, netmon.exe or Sandboxie service processes run.
Exits if vmwareuser.exe, vmwareservice.exe, vboxservice.exe, vboxtray.exe, vmsrvc.exe, vmusrvc.exe or SharedIntApp.exe run.
Calls NtQueryInformationProcess to detect a debug port.
Calls NtQuerySystemInformation to detect a kernel debugger.
Checks whether the WOW32Reserved transition (Wow64cpu.dll) has been hooked.
Stops if its own process name matches a hash or is longer than 31 characters without spaces (hash-style sample names).
Stops on user names cuckoo, sandbox-, nmsdbox-, xxxx-ox-, cwsx-, wilbert-sc, xpamast-sc.

threats.weight_basis: CISA AA22-216A lists FormBook among the top malware strains of 2021; XLoader is its MaaS successor. Not in the ANY.RUN 2024/2025 top-10.

threats.name: Astaroth

evidence.detail: Checks user names associated with analyst environments (ATT&CK S0373, citing Kaspersky GReAT, 'The Tetrade', 14 Jul 2020).
Checks disk serial numbers associated with analyst environments (ATT&CK S0373).

threats.weight_basis: Brazilian banking trojan (Kaspersky 'Tetrade', 2020); regional commodity family: 0.5.

threats.name: Attor

evidence.detail: Detects virtualised environments by communicating with hypervisor I/O ports (ATT&CK S0438, citing ESET, Oct 2019).
Uses VM-specific instructions to detect virtual or emulated environments (ATT&CK S0438).

threats.weight_basis: Espionage platform seen in a few targeted attacks in Eastern Europe (ESET 2019): 0.2.

threats.name: BadPatch

evidence.detail: WMI query for the disk drive name (ATT&CK S0337, citing Unit 42, 20 Oct 2017).
WMI query for BIOS and motherboard information (ATT&CK S0337).

threats.weight_basis: Gaza-cybergang-linked espionage tool (Unit 42, 2017): 0.2.

threats.name: BlackByte

evidence.detail: Checks for files related to known sandboxes (ATT&CK S1180, citing Trustwave, 15 Oct 2021).
Terminates if the system language matches a hard-coded list (Russian and former Soviet languages) (ATT&CK S1180).

threats.weight_basis: Ransomware-as-a-service brand active 2021-2024; judgement weight for a mid-sized brand: 0.6.

threats.name: BLUELIGHT

evidence.detail: Checks whether VM tools are running (ATT&CK S0657, citing Volexity, 17 Aug 2021).

threats.weight_basis: APT37/InkySquid backdoor from targeted watering-hole attacks (Volexity 2021): 0.2.

threats.name: CSPY Downloader

evidence.detail: Searches loaded modules for analysis DLLs (ATT&CK S0527, citing Cybereason, 2 Nov 2020).
Inspects the PEB to determine whether it is being debugged (ATT&CK S0527).
Searches file paths of virtualisation software (ATT&CK S0527).
Searches registry keys of virtualisation software (ATT&CK S0527).

threats.weight_basis: Kimsuky downloader (Cybereason 2020): APT tooling 0.3.

threats.name: Darkhotel tooling

evidence.detail: Checks the length of the executable name, a name ending in .Md5.exe, and execution from the root of C:\ (ATT&CK G0012, citing Lastline, 5 Nov 2015, and Microsoft 'DUBNIUM', 9 Jun 2016).
Checks for sandbox-related libraries (ATT&CK G0012).
Repeatedly checks the mouse cursor position to decide whether a real user is present (ATT&CK G0012, citing Lastline 2015).

threats.weight_basis: Long-running espionage actor; APT tooling 0.3.

threats.name: DarkTortilla

evidence.detail: Searches running processes for Hyper-V, QEMU, Virtual PC, VirtualBox and VMware (ATT&CK S1066, citing Secureworks CTU, 17 Aug 2022).
Searches services for the same hypervisors (ATT&CK S1066).
Detects Sandboxie (ATT&CK S1066).
Uses Debugger.IsAttached and Debugger.IsLogging (ATT&CK S1066).
Detects profilers through the COR_ENABLE_PROFILING environment variable (ATT&CK S1066).

threats.weight_basis: Commodity .NET crypter used to wrap infostealers and RATs; judgement weight for a mid-tier wrapper: 0.8.

threats.name: Dyre

evidence.detail: Inspects the process list to detect sandbox analysis (ATT&CK S0024, citing Symantec 23 Jun 2015 and hasherezade 4 Nov 2015).
Inspects the registry for sandbox artifacts (ATT&CK S0024).

threats.weight_basis: Historic banking trojan (Symantec 2015), inactive since 2016: 0.3.

threats.name: EvilBunny

evidence.detail: Dropper checks the number of running processes (ATT&CK S0396, citing Marschalek, 16 Dec 2014).
Dropper checks the length and strings of its own file name (ATT&CK S0396).
Takes time measurements from three APIs before and after sleeping and aborts on a mismatch (ATT&CK S0396).

threats.weight_basis: Animal Farm espionage implant (Marschalek 2014): 0.2.

threats.name: Ferocious

evidence.detail: Excel 4.0 GET.WORKSPACE checks whether a mouse is present (ATT&CK S0679, citing Kaspersky, 29 Nov 2021).
GET.WORKSPACE checks whether the host can play sounds (ATT&CK S0679).

threats.weight_basis: WIRTE Excel 4.0 dropper (Kaspersky 2021): 0.2.

threats.name: FinFisher

evidence.detail: Gets the hardware device list and compares MD5 hashes of vendor IDs with a predefined list (ATT&CK S0182, citing Microsoft, 1 Mar 2018).

threats.weight_basis: Commercial surveillance kit (Microsoft 2018): 0.3.

threats.name: Frankenstein campaign tooling

evidence.detail: WMI query of the number of cores; stops if fewer than two (ATT&CK C0001, citing Talos, 4 Jun 2019).
WMI queries to determine whether analysis tools are running (ATT&CK C0001).

threats.weight_basis: Single campaign built from open-source pieces (Talos 2019): 0.2.

threats.name: GoldMax

evidence.detail: Compares the collected MAC address with c8:27:cc:c2:37:5a to detect a virtualised environment (ATT&CK S0588, citing Microsoft, 4 Mar 2021).

threats.weight_basis: APT29 second-stage backdoor (Microsoft/Mandiant 2021): 0.3.

threats.name: Grandoreiro

evidence.detail: Detects VMware through its I/O port (ATT&CK S0531, citing ESET, 28 Apr 2020).
Detects Virtual PC with the vpcext instruction (ATT&CK S0531).

threats.weight_basis: Latin-American banking trojan family; judgement weight: 0.6.

threats.name: GravityRAT

evidence.detail: WMI BIOS and manufacturer information checked for VMWare, Virtual and XEN (ATT&CK S0237, citing Talos, 26 Apr 2018).
WMI request for the hardware temperature; no reading means a VM (ATT&CK S0237).

threats.weight_basis: Espionage RAT targeting India (Talos 2018): 0.3.

threats.name: Kimsuky PowerShell tooling

evidence.detail: Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem; exits if Manufacturer matches VMware, Microsoft or VirtualBox (ATT&CK G0094, citing Krishnasamy & Sood, 29 Jul 2025).

threats.weight_basis: North Korean espionage actor: APT tooling 0.3.

threats.name: Lucifer

evidence.detail: Checks user names associated with sandboxes (ATT&CK S0532, citing Unit 42, 24 Jun 2020).
Checks computer names associated with sandboxes (ATT&CK S0532).
Checks device drivers and virtual devices of VMs (ATT&CK S0532).
Checks DLLs associated with sandboxes (ATT&CK S0532).

threats.weight_basis: Cryptojacking/DDoS hybrid (Unit 42 2020): 0.3.

threats.name: MegaCortex

evidence.detail: Checks the number of CPUs to avoid sandboxes and emulators (ATT&CK S0576, citing IBM X-Force, 8 Jan 2020).

threats.weight_basis: Targeted ransomware 2019-2020 (IBM 2020): 0.3.

threats.name: MiniBus

evidence.detail: Detects processes associated with virtual machines (ATT&CK S9060, citing Mandiant, 27 Feb 2024).

threats.weight_basis: UNC1549 backdoor (Mandiant 2024): 0.2.

threats.name: Mispadu

evidence.detail: Terminates if the computer name is JOHN-PC (ATT&CK S1122, citing ESET, 19 Nov 2019).
Terminates if the language ID is not Spanish or Portuguese (ATT&CK S1122, citing SCILabs, 23 Dec 2021).

threats.weight_basis: Latin-American banking trojan (ESET 2019): 0.5.

threats.name: ObliqueRAT

evidence.detail: Halts if processes of virtual-machine software run (ATT&CK S0644, citing Talos, 2 Mar 2021).
Halts if processes of analysis tools run (ATT&CK S0644).

threats.weight_basis: Transparent Tribe RAT (Talos 2021): 0.3.

threats.name: OilRig macro and OopsIE tooling

evidence.detail: OopsIE runs WMI SELECT * FROM MSAcpi_ThermalZoneTemperature; no reading means a VM (ATT&CK S0264, citing Unit 42, 4 Sep 2018).
Macros verify that a mouse is connected (ATT&CK G0049, citing Check Point, 8 Apr 2021).

threats.weight_basis: Iranian APT34 tooling: 0.3.

threats.name: Okrum

evidence.detail: Loader terminates if the host has less than 1.5 GB of physical memory (ATT&CK S0439, citing ESET, Jul 2019).
Loader runs the payload only after the left mouse button has been pressed at least three times (ATT&CK S0439).
Loader calls GetTickCount twice around a delay to detect accelerated time (ATT&CK S0439).

threats.weight_basis: Ke3chang backdoor (ESET 2019): 0.3.

threats.name: Operation Dream Job tooling

evidence.detail: Tools check for VMware services (ATT&CK C0022, citing ClearSky, 13 Aug 2020).
DRATzarus uses IsDebuggerPresent (ATT&CK S0694).
Malware designed not to run on systems set to Korean, Japanese or Chinese (ATT&CK C0022).

threats.weight_basis: Lazarus long-running campaign (ClearSky 2020); APT tooling with broad reach: 0.4.

threats.name: P8RAT

evidence.detail: Checks for VMware or VirtualBox processes (ATT&CK S0626, citing Kaspersky, 30 Mar 2021).

threats.weight_basis: APT10 A41APT backdoor (Kaspersky 2021): 0.2.

threats.name: SodaMaster

evidence.detail: Checks for HKCR\Applications\VMwareHostOpen.exe before running (ATT&CK S0627, citing Kaspersky, 30 Mar 2021).

threats.weight_basis: APT10 A41APT backdoor (Kaspersky 2021): 0.2.

threats.name: PlugX

evidence.detail: Searches for a process named vmtoolsd (ATT&CK S0013, citing Unit 42 'Paranoid PlugX', 27 Jun 2017).
Calls CheckRemoteDebuggerPresent and exits if a debugger is found (ATT&CK S0013, citing Talos, 5 May 2022).

threats.weight_basis: Shared by many China-nexus actors for over 15 years; the most widespread APT RAT, so above other APT tooling: 0.6.

threats.name: PoetRAT

evidence.detail: Checks the hard-drive size to detect a sandbox, then deletes itself (ATT&CK S0428, citing Talos, 16 Apr 2020).

threats.weight_basis: Python RAT in a targeted campaign (Talos 2020): 0.2.

threats.name: RogueRobin

evidence.detail: WMI check of the BIOS version for VBOX, bochs, qemu, virtualbox and vm (ATT&CK S0270, citing Unit 42, 27 Jul 2018).
Searches running processes for Wireshark and the Sysinternals suite (ATT&CK S0270).

threats.weight_basis: DarkHydrus trojan (Unit 42 2018/2019): 0.2.

threats.name: ROKRAT

evidence.detail: Checks for VMware-related files (ATT&CK S0240, citing Talos 16 Jan 2018 and NCC Group 8 Nov 2018).
Checks for DLLs related to sandboxes (ATT&CK S0240).
Checks for debugging tools (ATT&CK S0240).

threats.weight_basis: APT37's main implant, used in many campaigns: 0.4.

threats.name: Saint Bot

evidence.detail: Checks for Sbiedll.dll among loaded modules (ATT&CK S1018, citing Unit 42, 25 Feb 2022).
Compares the machine name with HAL9TH (Defender emulator) (ATT&CK S1018).
Compares the user name with JohnDoe (ATT&CK S1018).
Checks the BIOS version for virtual-machine identifiers (ATT&CK S1018).
Uses is_debugger_present (ATT&CK S1018, citing hasherezade, 6 Apr 2021).

threats.weight_basis: Downloader used against Ukraine (Unit 42 2022; Malwarebytes 2021): 0.3.

threats.name: Shark

evidence.detail: Stops if the screen width is not over 600 pixels (ATT&CK S1019, citing ClearSky, Aug 2021).

threats.weight_basis: Lyceum backdoor (ClearSky 2021): 0.2.

threats.name: Snip3

evidence.detail: Queries Win32_ComputerSystem Manufacturer to detect VMware or VirtualBox (ATT&CK S1086, citing Morphisec, 7 May 2021).
Detects Windows Sandbox from the same Manufacturer string (ATT&CK S1086).

threats.weight_basis: Crypter-as-a-service used to deliver RATs; judgement weight: 0.6.

threats.name: SynAck

evidence.detail: Checks its directory location to avoid sandboxes (ATT&CK S0242, citing Kaspersky, 7 May 2018).
Lists keyboard layouts with GetKeyboardLayoutList and exits on a hard-coded list (ATT&CK S0242).

threats.weight_basis: Targeted ransomware (Kaspersky 2018): 0.3.

threats.name: Trojan.Karagany

evidence.detail: Detects virtualisation platforms by their drivers (ATT&CK S0094, citing Secureworks, 24 Jul 2019).
Detects virtualisation platforms by file paths (ATT&CK S0094).

threats.weight_basis: Dragonfly tooling (Secureworks 2019): 0.2.

threats.name: WhisperGate

evidence.detail: Stops when it recognises monitoring tools (ATT&CK S0689, citing Unit 42, 20 Jan 2022).

threats.weight_basis: Destructive malware used against Ukraine (Unit 42 2022): 0.2.

threats.name: Spark

evidence.detail: Shows a splash screen and waits for the user to click before running (ATT&CK S0543, citing Unit 42, 3 Mar 2020).
Requires GetKeyboardLayoutList/GetLocaleInfoA to contain 'Arabic' (ATT&CK S0543).

threats.weight_basis: Molerats backdoor (Unit 42 2020): 0.2.

threats.name: TONESHELL

evidence.detail: Calls GetForegroundWindow twice and compares the handles to detect sandboxes (ATT&CK S1239, citing Trend Micro, 18 Nov 2022).

threats.weight_basis: Mustang Panda backdoor in many 2022-2025 campaigns: 0.3.

threats.name: ROAMINGHOUSE

evidence.detail: Checks for specific mouse movements and user activity before starting (ATT&CK S9026, citing Trend Micro, 26 Nov 2024).

threats.weight_basis: Earth Kasha (APT10) loader (Trend Micro 2024): 0.2.

threats.name: Cobalt Strike loaders

evidence.detail: Loader calls MessageBoxA and waits for the user to answer before continuing (ATT&CK S0154, citing Takeda et al., 26 Oct 2025, Qilin cases).

threats.weight_basis: Cobalt Strike is a widely abused post-exploitation framework; only its loaders' documented gate is listed; judgement weight: 1.0.

threats.name: LockBit

evidence.detail: LockBit 2.0 and 3.0 do not run when the system language is on an exclusion list of mainly Eastern European languages (ATT&CK S1199/S1202, citing FBI 4 Feb 2022 and FBI/CISA 16 Mar 2023).
LockBit 3.0 checks heap memory parameters (heap flags) for signs of a debugger (ATT&CK S1202, citing SentinelOne, 21 Jul 2022).

threats.weight_basis: Most prolific RaaS brand of 2022-2023 per the joint CISA/FBI LockBit advisories cited by ATT&CK; ransomware samples are rarer in sandboxes than stealers: 1.0.

threats.name: StealBit

evidence.detail: Detects when it runs under a debugger and then spins in an empty loop (ATT&CK S1200, citing an undated Cybereason report).
Does not run when the default language is that of a former Soviet country (ATT&CK S1200, citing an undated Cybereason report).

threats.weight_basis: LockBit's exfiltration tool: 0.3.

threats.name: REvil

evidence.detail: Calls GetUserDefaultUILanguage/GetSystemDefaultUILanguage and terminates on a language list (ATT&CK S0496, citing Kaspersky, 3 Jul 2019).

threats.weight_basis: Major RaaS 2019-2021, dormant since 2022: 0.6.

threats.name: Ryuk

evidence.detail: Reads HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Nls\Language InstallLanguage and stops on 0x419, 0x422, 0x423 (ATT&CK S0446, citing CrowdStrike, 10 Jan 2019).

threats.weight_basis: Big-game-hunting ransomware 2018-2021 (CrowdStrike 2019): 0.5.

threats.name: Maze

evidence.detail: Calls GetUserDefaultUILanguage and terminates on a predefined language list (ATT&CK S0449, citing McAfee, 26 Mar 2020).

threats.weight_basis: Major ransomware of 2019-2020, retired 2020: 0.4.

threats.name: Clop

evidence.detail: Checks the keyboard layout with GetKeyboardLayout (and GetTextCharset) to avoid Russian/CIS machines (ATT&CK S0611, citing McAfee, 1 Aug 2019).

threats.weight_basis: Clop's mass-exploitation campaigns made it a top extortion brand: 0.7.

threats.name: Cuba

evidence.detail: Checks whether Russian is installed using GetKeyboardLayoutList (ATT&CK S0625, citing McAfee, Apr 2021).

threats.weight_basis: Mid-sized ransomware brand: 0.4.

threats.name: Avaddon

evidence.detail: Checks keyboard layouts and OS languages to avoid CIS targets (ATT&CK S0640, citing Yuste & Pastrana, 9 Feb 2021).

threats.weight_basis: RaaS active 2020-2021: 0.3.

threats.name: DEATHRANSOM

evidence.detail: Some versions exit if the language ID or keyboard layout is Russian, Kazakh, Belarusian, Ukrainian or Tatar (ATT&CK S0616, citing Mandiant, 29 Apr 2021).

threats.weight_basis: Small ransomware used by UNC2447 (Mandiant 2021): 0.2.

threats.name: Zeus Panda

evidence.detail: Queries the keyboard mapping and terminates on LANG_RUSSIAN, LANG_BELARUSIAN, LANG_KAZAK, LANG_UKRAINIAN (ATT&CK S0330, citing Talos, 2 Nov 2017).

threats.weight_basis: Zeus-derived banker (Talos 2017): 0.3.

threats.name: StrelaStealer

evidence.detail: Only runs if the keyboard layout or language matches a configured list (ATT&CK S1183, citing Fortgale 18 Sep 2023 and IBM X-Force 12 Nov 2024).

threats.weight_basis: Email-credential stealer in large European spam waves (Unit 42 2024, IBM 2024): 0.5.

threats.name: BazarLoader

evidence.detail: Checks that the keyboard and language settings are not Russian (ATT&CK S0534, citing NCC Group, 2 Jun 2020).

threats.weight_basis: TrickBot-gang loader 2020-2022 (NCC Group 2020): 0.5.

threats.name: PureCrypter

evidence.detail: Calls CheckRemoteDebuggerPresent (ATT&CK S9019, citing Zscaler/Dumont, 13 Jun 2022).
ExclusionRegionNames option compares kernel32!GetGeoInfo results with a list of regions (ATT&CK S9019).

threats.weight_basis: ANY.RUN 2025 annual report names PureCrypter among the widespread loaders.

threats.name: Tsundere botnet

evidence.detail: Checks the machine location to avoid CIS countries (ATT&CK S9034, citing Kaspersky, 20 Nov 2025).

threats.weight_basis: New Node.js botnet (Kaspersky 2025): 0.3.

threats.name: GlassWorm

evidence.detail: Checks for ru_RU, ru-RU, ru and Russian locale settings and does not run on them (ATT&CK S9010, citing Socket, 31 Jan 2026).

threats.weight_basis: Self-spreading malicious VS Code/Open VSX extension campaign (Socket 2026): 0.3.

threats.name: MarkiRAT

evidence.detail: Uses GetKeyboardLayout to check whether the keyboard is set to Persian (ATT&CK S0652, citing Kaspersky, 16 Jun 2021).

threats.weight_basis: Ferocious Kitten surveillance RAT (Kaspersky 2021): 0.2.

threats.name: Mini Shai-Hulud

evidence.detail: Exits when fewer than four (in other versions two) CPUs are present (ATT&CK S9043, citing McCarthy et al. 12 May 2026 and Hunt.io 14 May 2026).
Terminates when the system is configured for Russian (ATT&CK S9043).

threats.weight_basis: npm/PyPI supply-chain worm that runs on developer machines and CI runners (ATT&CK S9043): 0.4.

threats.name: Cuckoo Stealer

evidence.detail: Reads LANG and does not infect hy_AM, be_BY, kk_KZ, ru_RU, uk_UA systems (ATT&CK S1153, citing Kandji, 30 Apr 2024).

threats.weight_basis: macOS infostealer/spyware (Kandji 2024): 0.4.

threats.name: ThiefQuest

evidence.detail: Calls time, sleeps, calls time again and compares the difference with the time slept to detect a sandbox (ATT&CK S0595, citing Wardle, 29 Jun 2020).
is_debugging() uses sysctl to test P_TRACED; also calls ptrace(PT_DENY_ATTACH) (ATT&CK S0595, citing Wardle, 3 Jul 2020).

threats.weight_basis: macOS ransomware/wiper (Wardle 2020): 0.3.

threats.name: OceanLotus macOS backdoor

evidence.detail: Checks sysctl hw.model to tell real hardware from a virtual machine (ATT&CK S0352, citing ESET, 9 Apr 2019).
Checks the kernel boot time (ATT&CK S0352).

threats.weight_basis: APT32 macOS backdoor (Unit 42 2017, ESET 2019): 0.3.

threats.name: OSAMiner

evidence.detail: Parses system_profiler output to check whether the machine has 4 cores (ATT&CK S1048, citing SentinelOne, 11 Jan 2021).

threats.weight_basis: macOS cryptominer spread via pirated games (SentinelOne 2021): 0.3.

threats.name: SUNBURST

evidence.detail: Stops if the host is not joined to an AD domain, and if the domain matches a blocklist (swdev.local, lab.local, test, ...).
Hashes running process names against a blocklist of analysis and security tools and pauses if one matches.
Hashes driver filenames from Win32_SystemDriver and services against blocklists; a match halts or postpones it.

threats.weight_basis: Single supply-chain operation with high impact but a narrow population: 0.3.

threats.name: Kazuar

evidence.detail: Idles if processes such as Process Monitor, x32dbg, dnSpy or Wireshark run.
Checks for sandbox DLLs dir_watch.dll, cmdvrt32.dll, sbiedll.dll, api_log.dll, pstorec.dll, sxin.dll.
Flags a Kaspersky honeypot if more than five decoy files (Financial_report.xls, Passwords.txt, ...) or processes exist.

threats.weight_basis: Turla espionage backdoor, targeted use only: 0.3.

threats.name: Rhadamanthys

evidence.detail: The 'Strategy' module compares running processes with a forbidden list before contacting C2.
Looks for sandbox sample files foobar.jpg/.mp3/.txt/.wri and waller.dat, and identical keys.txt/passwords.txt.
Compares the user name with JohnDeo, HAL9TH, JOHN, JOHN-PC, MUELLER-PC, george, DESKTOP-B0T.
Gets the MAC through UuidCreateSequential (UUIDv1 node) and compares it with a list of virtual interfaces.
Compares Win32_ComputerSystemProduct UUID with a list of known sandbox HWIDs.

threats.weight_basis: MaaS stealer with major releases through 2025 (Check Point): 1.0.

threats.name: Locky

evidence.detail: Calls RDTSC three times and exits if the ratio of the two deltas exceeds 10, taken as emulation overhead.
Polls GetForegroundWindow and only unpacks after the foreground window has changed enough times.

threats.weight_basis: One of the most distributed ransomware families of 2016 (Cyberbit calls it 'one of the most dominant'); inactive since 2017: 0.6.

threats.name: WannaCry

evidence.detail: Connects to a hard-coded unregistered domain and exits if it answers, which happens in sandboxes that answer every lookup.

threats.weight_basis: Global worm outbreak of May 2017, halted by the kill-switch domain; little activity since: 0.4.

threats.name: Meduza Stealer

evidence.detail: Terminates if the GeoID is RU, KZ, BY, GE, TM, UZ, AM, KG, MD or TJ.

threats.weight_basis: MaaS stealer sold on Russian-speaking forums from June 2023: 0.5.

threats.name: Mars Stealer

evidence.detail: Anti-CIS: exits if GetUserDefaultLangID returns Russian, Belarusian, Kazakh, Uzbek or Azerbaijani.

threats.weight_basis: Oski-derived stealer widely sold in 2021-2022: 0.5.

threats.name: DropBook

evidence.detail: Checks for Arabic in the machine's language settings (ATT&CK S0547, citing Cybereason, 2020).

threats.weight_basis: Molerats espionage backdoor, targeted use: 0.2.

threats.name: SharpStage

evidence.detail: Runs only if the Arabic language is installed (ATT&CK S0546, citing Cybereason, 2020).

threats.weight_basis: Molerats espionage backdoor, targeted use: 0.2.

threats.name: Flagpro

evidence.detail: Checks whether the system uses Japanese, Taiwanese or English by looking for specific localised dialogs (ATT&CK S0696, citing NTT Security, 2021).

threats.weight_basis: BlackTech downloader, targeted use against Japan: 0.2.

threats.name: Misdat

evidence.detail: Calls GetKeyboardType to detect a Japanese keyboard (ATT&CK S0083, citing Cylance, 2016).

threats.weight_basis: Operation Dust Storm tooling, targeted use: 0.2.

threats.name: S-Type

evidence.detail: Calls GetKeyboardType to detect a Japanese keyboard (ATT&CK S0085, citing Cylance, 2016).

threats.weight_basis: Operation Dust Storm tooling, targeted use: 0.2.

threats.name: LODEINFO

evidence.detail: Looks for the en_US locale on the victim (ATT&CK S9020).

threats.weight_basis: APT10-linked backdoor targeting Japan: 0.2.

threats.name: Gootloader

evidence.detail: Checks whether the OS has specific language preferences before continuing (ATT&CK S1138).

threats.weight_basis: Named among the 2021 top strains in CISA AA22-216A: 1.0.

threats.name: Necurs

evidence.detail: Resolves five random domains and exits if they all return the same IP, the signature of a sandbox's catch-all DNS (described by MalwareTech).

threats.weight_basis: Large spam botnet until its 2020 disruption; judgement weight: 0.4.

threats.name: Mirai and derivatives

evidence.detail: main() installs anti_gdb_entry as the SIGTRAP handler and raises SIGTRAP; under gdb the signal is swallowed and the real C2 resolver is never installed.
Samples in the wild keep the SIGTRAP trick and move the C2 address into the handler's resolve_cnc_addr.

threats.weight_basis: Judgement weight: Mirai derivatives are the most frequently reported Linux/IoT botnet code base in vendor reporting since the 2016 source leak (e.g. GorillaBot, ANY.RUN 2025); no census-grade share is published.

threats.name: GorillaBot

evidence.detail: Reads TracerPid from /proc/self/status and exits if non-zero.
Registers a SIGTRAP callback that pauses and exits.
Reads /proc/1/cgroup and exits if it contains 'kubepods'; also exits if /proc is missing (honeypot).

threats.weight_basis: Mirai-derived botnet active 2024-2025 (ANY.RUN 2025): 0.6.

threats.name: P2Pinfect

evidence.detail: MIPS variant forks, reads /proc/<pid>/status and kills parent and child if TracerPid is non-zero.

threats.weight_basis: Rust P2P worm against Redis/SSH (Cado/Darktrace 2023): 0.5.

threats.name: QuimaRAT

evidence.detail: Reads /sys/class/dmi/id/product_name and sys_vendor for virtualbox, vmware, kvm, qemu, xen, parallels, bhyve, innotek, microsoft.
Counts 'hypervisor' in /proc/cpuinfo flags.
Checks for /usr/bin/qemu-ga, /usr/sbin/VBoxService and /usr/bin/vmtoolsd.
Reads /proc/scsi/scsi for vbox or vmware.

threats.weight_basis: Java cross-platform RAT (LevelBlue 2026); only its Linux checks are listed: 0.3.

threats.name: CanisterWorm

evidence.detail: Checks /etc/timezone and timedatectl for Asia/Tehran or Iran and LANG for fa_IR before running the wiper (ATT&CK S9042, citing Unit 42 31 Mar 2026 and Eriksen 22 Mar 2026).

threats.weight_basis: TeamPCP supply-chain worm with a geofenced Kubernetes wiper (ATT&CK S9042): 0.2.

threats.name: Atomic macOS Stealer

evidence.detail: Runs system_profiler SPHardwareDataType and exits (code 0x1b) if the output contains 'VMware' or 'Apple Virtual Machine'.
Newer builds run system_profiler SPMemoryDataType through osascript and exit 42 if it mentions QEMU or VMware.

threats.weight_basis: Unit 42 (4 Feb 2025) names Atomic, Poseidon and Cthulhu as the three most prevalent macOS infostealers in its telemetry; Atomic is the most widely reported of them: top macOS weight.

threats.name: Banshee Stealer

evidence.detail: Uses sysctl to test whether a debugger is attached (P_TRACED).
Runs system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep 'Model Identifier' and stops if it contains 'Virtual'.
Reads CFLocaleCopyPreferredLanguages and stops if the language is 'ru'.

threats.weight_basis: macOS MaaS stealer (Elastic 2024); Iru (2025) analyses a rewrite based on its leaked source: 1.0.

threats.name: XLoader (macOS)

evidence.detail: Uses a ptrace-based anti-debugging check at initialisation.

threats.weight_basis: macOS build of the FormBook successor (Check Point 2021): 0.6.

threats.name: Amnesia

evidence.detail: Searches /sys/class/dmi/id/product_name and sys_vendor for 'VirtualBox' and 'QEMU' (as described by Kedrowitsch et al., citing Palo Alto Networks).
Detects VirtualBox, VMware or QEMU virtual machines and, if found, wipes the file system (Palo Alto Networks, quoted).

threats.weight_basis: Tsunami-derived DVR botnet; Palo Alto Networks called it the first Linux malware to try to evade sandboxes (2017): 0.3.

threats.name: Decoy Dog

evidence.detail: The loader reads TracerPid from /proc/self/status and replaces itself with /bin/sh via execve if it is non-zero.

threats.weight_basis: Pupy-based backdoor of the Hellhounds group, at least 48 Russian victims by Q2 2024 (PT ESC): 0.2.

threats.name: LockBit Linux-ESXi Locker

evidence.detail: Calls PTRACE_ATTACH on its own parent process and exits with status 1 if that fails, which happens when gdb or strace is already tracing it.

threats.weight_basis: Linux/ESXi build of LockBit, announced October 2021 (Trend Micro 2022); LockBit was the most-reported ransomware brand of 2022-2023 but no Linux-only share is published: 0.6.

threats.name: Payload ESXi locker

evidence.detail: First step of main reads TracerPid from /proc/self/status and exits if it is non-zero.

threats.weight_basis: ESXi encryptor of the 'payload' ransomware group, low-volume: 0.2.

threats.name: Anubis

evidence.detail: Google Play droppers only fetch the payload once the motion sensor reports the user moving; an emulator's static accelerometer never triggers it.

threats.weight_basis: No public census of Android family prevalence was found; judgement weight anchored on the cited report: Trend Micro (Jan 2019) reports the payload targeting 377 financial app variants in 93 countries: 1.0.

threats.name: Cerberus

evidence.detail: Uses the accelerometer as a pedometer and only continues once the step count passes a configured threshold.

threats.weight_basis: No public census of Android family prevalence was found; judgement weight anchored on the cited report: rented MaaS banker (ThreatFabric 2019) whose leaked code seeded later families such as Alien and ERMAC: 1.0.

threats.name: Mandrake

evidence.detail: Looks for Frida threads and named pipes and for Xposed and Substrate before continuing.
Checks for su, SuperUser.apk, Busybox and Magisk.
Checks whether developer settings and ADB are enabled.
Checks that a Google account is configured on the device.

threats.weight_basis: No public census of Android family prevalence was found; judgement weight anchored on the cited report: Google Play spyware platform that returned in 2024 (Securelist): 0.5.

threats.name: Godfather

evidence.detail: Stops if the system language is one of ru, az, hy, be, kk, ky, mo, uz or tg (CIS guardrail).

threats.weight_basis: No public census of Android family prevalence was found; judgement weight anchored on the cited report: Android banker with a large overlay target list (Group-IB 2022): 0.8.

threats.name: Anatsa

evidence.detail: The dropper's second stage checks the device environment and device model before fetching the final payload.
2025 droppers still run emulation checks and verify device models.
Downloaded dex checks model and manufacturer for emulator values before the APK is fetched.
Continues only if the registered operator's ISO-3166 country code is in a target list (es, sk, cz, gb, fi and others).
Code compares Build.MANUFACTURER/MODEL/HARDWARE/PRODUCT/FINGERPRINT with Genymotion, google_sdk, goldfish, vbox86, Nox and generic values.

threats.weight_basis: No public census of Android family prevalence was found; judgement weight anchored on the cited report: repeatedly reported Google Play dropper campaigns 2021-2025 (Zscaler 2024 and 2025, Cleafy 2024): 1.5.

threats.name: AbstractEmu

evidence.detail: Checks system properties for emulator values before running (ATT&CK S1061, citing Lookout, 2021-10-28).

threats.weight_basis: No public census of Android family prevalence was found; judgement weight anchored on the cited report: rooting malware found in 19 apps (Lookout 2021): 0.3.

threats.name: Android/AdDisplay.Ashas

evidence.detail: Stays dormant if the device's IP address falls in Google's ranges, the ones used by Play review (ATT&CK S0525, citing ESET, 2019-10-24).

threats.weight_basis: No public census of Android family prevalence was found; judgement weight anchored on the cited report: adware family in 42 Google Play apps (ESET 2019): 0.3.

threats.name: Chameleon

evidence.detail: Terminates if the device is rooted.
Terminates if debugging (ADB) is enabled.

threats.weight_basis: No public census of Android family prevalence was found; judgement weight anchored on the cited report: banker targeting Australia and Poland, later Europe (Cyble 2023): 0.5.

threats.name: TrickMo

evidence.detail: Checks whether the device is rooted before activating (ATT&CK S0558, citing IBM X-Force, 2020-03-24).

threats.weight_basis: No public census of Android family prevalence was found; judgement weight anchored on the cited report: TrickBot's Android companion (IBM X-Force 2020), still reported in 2024: 0.5.

threats.name: Rotexy

evidence.detail: On first launch shows only a stub page if the device is located outside Russia (it also checks for an emulator; the check is not described).

threats.weight_basis: No public census of Android family prevalence was found; judgement weight anchored on the cited report: Securelist counted over 70,000 attacks between August and October 2018: 0.6.

threats.name: Hydra

evidence.detail: isEmulator() matches Build BRAND/DEVICE/FINGERPRINT 'generic', HARDWARE goldfish/ranchu, MODEL google_sdk/Emulator, Genymotion and sdk/vbox86p products; the bot then never contacts C2.

threats.weight_basis: No public census of Android family prevalence was found; judgement weight anchored on the cited report: MaaS banker active since 2018; Fortinet found 20+ C2 panels in 2022 (VB2022): 0.8.

threats.name: SharkBot

evidence.detail: Droppers only proceed if the SIM ISO country is IT or GB.
Droppers also require at least one targeted banking app to be installed.

threats.weight_basis: No public census of Android family prevalence was found; judgement weight anchored on the cited report: ATS banker distributed through Google Play droppers (Cleafy 2021, Bitdefender 2022): 0.6.

threats.name: SpinOk

evidence.detail: Collects gyroscope and magnetometer data to recognise emulators and change behaviour (Doctor Web finding).

threats.weight_basis: No public census of Android family prevalence was found; judgement weight anchored on the cited report: Doctor Web found the SDK in 101 apps with 421 million downloads: 0.8.
